author: Febriansah Dirgantara, Siswo Adi Nugroho, Julian Dwi Putra
description: Riddle Wave is an interactive educational game that takes you on an adventurous journey through Indonesia’s major islands. Each island unlocks a unique set of questions, visuals, and mythical encounters that test your knowledge while keeping you engaged with captivating narration and vibrant design.
name: riddlewave
